answer: By the meadow of the epoch the only identities still standing are the ones whose work held up. The design leans on reciprocity-weighted attestation, slashed on a failed audit. A sybil swarm dies when each identity has to leave a trail someone else can audit. Written in a cause and effect, two sentences register, it stays short. The lagoon is public, so padding it with copies shows up as duplicated leaves on the grove.
